methods_text: Codon alignments were built with COAL v0.5.0 (https://github.com/plumat-coal/COAL), which places each coding DNA sequence onto the protein multiple sequence alignment codon by codon (the method of PAL2NAL; Suyama et al. 2006), using the standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1). Of 9 sequences, 6 matched their protein exactly; 1 was written to the output but flagged as probably wrong (most likely the wrong DNA, a shifted position or the wrong genetic code); remove it before analysis; and 2 could not be aligned and were excluded.
